title: Kosher Braised Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring tender lamb, red onions, and a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a comforting meal on a sick day. This recipe is kosher-friendly and serves 6 people.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced red onions and cook until they are caramelized and golden brown.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and dried prunes, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the oven, where it will braise for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley and a side of couscous.
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
